citations.claim: body centre jumped from x=8 to x=10 in one step, landing on wall edge
first violation: centre at wall edge x=10 with deep overlap, distance_to_surface -0.5 exceeds 0.15 limit

explanation: Fast body (vx=60) with large dt=1/30 moves 2.0 per step. Engine splits into only 4 substeps (0.5 per substep), larger than wall thickness 0.1 plus handling, so discrete collision misses thin wall. Body jumps from x=8 to x=10 and ends embedded in wall with 0.5 overlap, breaking no_wall_penetration. Likely cause: substep count capped too low / not scaled to velocity*dt vs min wall thickness + radius.
vision_note: The red circle remains left of the thin vertical wall through steps 1-3 and then appears centered directly on the wall line in step 4. The body ends up embedded overlapping the wall instead of colliding and staying on one side.
